This makes your work varied and exciting! #baanrader 🤩 Fortunately, you’ll be well-prepared: you start your job with an extensive training guided by a buddy. This colleague will teach you exactly how to deliver groceries on time and neatly. 💪 Ready for more? You can grow internally to become a buddy or a team leader through internal training programs. 🚀
